<function name="SetIK" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Enables or disable the inverse kinematic usage of this entity.
		<warning>Calling this with false outside of <page>ENTITY:Initialize</page> requires a model change to take effect.</warning>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="useIK" type="boolean" default="false">The state of the IK.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
